about_the_game:
Unleash your creativity with Photo Giraffe, a powerful local AI image generator that runs entirely on your own computer! Using a 3-billion-parameter image generation model, Photo Giraffe transforms your ideas into stunning images for free—with no internet connection or cloud processing required.

  • Runs 100% Locally – No data uploads, no external servers—everything happens on your GPU.

  • Fast & Efficient – Generate AI art in seconds, harnessing the power of your own hardware.

  • Endless Creativity – Create concept art, wallpapers, character designs, surreal scenes, and more!

  • Easy to Use – Just type a prompt and watch your imagination come to life.

  • Completely Free - No fees or in-app purchases.

Whether you're an artist, designer, or just exploring AI-generated art, Photo Giraffe gives you full creative freedom—without any fees or in-app purchases. Download now and start generating!
